data.name: Jabar
data.gender_notes: Jabar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'J-B-R' meaning 'to raise, exalt, or be above'. In Islamic tradition, Jabar can refer to Allah or a righteous person who is exalted above others. The name Jabar carries the meaning “The Exalted One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jabar usually hope their child will grow to embody the exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies divine exaltation and righteousness.
data.etymology: Jabar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Exalted One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jabar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_english.name: Jabar
in_english.meaning: Name Jabar means strong, powerful, dominant, great
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jabar is derived from the Arabic root ج-ب-ر, which means strong, powerful, dominant, great. It is a name that reflects the power and greatness of Allah. In Islamic tradition, Jabar is one of the names of Allah, indicating His power and dominion over all creation. A person named Jabar is expected to exhibit strong qualities, such as courage, confidence, and determination. The name Jabar is also associated with spiritual growth and development, as it represents the power of Allah to guide and protect His servants.
